description: Validates ASN.1 schema definitions syntax and semantics. Use this tool whenever a user asks to validate, check, or verify an ASN.1 schema without generating source code. The tool returns a list of messages (informational, warnings, and errors).

fileName.description: The name of the schema file being validated. This should end in '.asn' (e.g., 'Rocket.asn'). If not provided, defaults to 'schema.asn'. It is used for errors to reference a specific location in the schema.

schemaContent.description: Plain-text ASN.1 schema definition. This must be valid ASN.1 syntax, typically starting with the 'DEFINITIONS' keyword and concluding with 'END'.

name: validate_asn1_schema
